$comment: Stackra file contract — Purpose: the mobile app's page strings, one object per route key (namespace `pages::`, locale `en`). Boundary: same keys in every base locale (gen fails otherwise); every Arabic plural carries all six CLDR categories (zero, one, two, few, many, other) or gen fails. Each route key's `title` is the route's derived title (also the tab label and the native header) and is never authored elsewhere; every other key is authored. A regional overlay (`en-US`, `ar-SA`) holds only the keys whose wording differs there. Strings of another module are overrides under src/overrides/<owner>/, never here. Runtime: react-native. Governing contract: ADR 0294 (decision 20), ADR 0192, ADR 0234, ADR 0080
